how_we_check.title: How we check
how_we_check.lead: We check how a VC fund deals with founders, using public sources you can open yourself. Every fact links to where it came from.
steps: Government lists, SEC filings, court dockets and named press for the fund, its advisers and its partners.
An exact identity match, never name-only. Copycat names are left out.
A fact counts only if it links to the record, names the fund and shows its role.
Open each check, follow the link to the original, save the fund and draw your own conclusions.
areas: Lawsuits by or against the fund, and its partners as directors, in US federal and state courts.
Registration filings, enforcement actions, and government sanctions and restriction lists.
Named, dated reporting from established outlets. Anonymous-only claims don’t count.
Partners and advisers named in filings, checked against the same records.
how_we_check.read_p: Each check shows a pill, not a grade. A pill tells you what we found, then you open the source.
read_list: Clear means we found nothing in the sources we checked. It is not a guarantee.
Review means there is a record worth reading. Counts show how many.
principles: Exact matches only. Copycat names are excluded.
A suit the fund brought is shown differently from one brought against it.
A lawsuit or probe is not a finding of wrongdoing.
Where a source has no data, we say so instead of guessing.
how_we_check.corr_p: Spotted a wrong fact? Send the page, what’s wrong and a source. We review every request.
how_we_check.disclaimer: Public-record information, not legal or investment advice. Records can be incomplete or out of date.
